title: Identity Pass
tagline: Reveal your real identity, we just created better ID for everyone;)
description: In our project, Identity Pass, we utilize World ID to develop a unified digital identity system, which combines personal information, health information, and preferences into a single, secure card for users. As a result, privacy and security are enhanced because every user has their own, unique, verifiable identity, eliminating the need for multiple identities. It is the goal of Identity Pass to incorporate a color-based reward system that will encourage community engagement and score user contributions. As a result of our solution, event registration, job applications, and clinical visits are simplified. Furthermore, positive contributions are made to the ecosystem through our solution.
how_its_made:
We started with the idea of using World ID to give everyone a unique digital identity. Our goal was to create a system that consolidates personal information, like gender identity, diet preferences, and health data, into one secure digital card. We focused on enhancing privacy and security by ensuring each person has a single, verifiable identity. Our design prioritizes user-friendly interfaces that allow individuals to control their own information easily.

  Identity Pass is designed to simplify life in three key areas: managing identities, integrating health data, and providing rewards. Users can easily update their identities and preferences through our platform. We integrate health data, such as cycle tracking and pain levels, to offer a comprehensive personal profile. Our reward system scores users based on their contributions, such as participating in events and community activities. These scores are visually represented through a color system, encouraging positive engagement. To build our proof of concept, we mapped out a detailed plan. We’ll use secure storage to protect user information and ensure privacy. APIs will facilitate the integration of health data from various sources. 
  Our reward system will track and score user contributions, displaying these scores visually on user profiles. Next, we’ll create wireframes and mockups to illustrate the user interface, followed by developing prototypes to test and refine the features. This iterative process will help us perfect the concept and prepare for full-scale development.
